narrative: NQ is recovering from a significant multi-day decline, trading at 25,585.50 — only 113.5 pts above the critical quarterly open support at 25,472. Short-term momentum on 15m and 1H has turned bullish as price bounced off recent lows and reclaimed VWAP, but the 4H and daily structure remains firmly bearish with price sitting well below the 4H EMA cluster (25,655–25,712). Institutions appear to be selling into this morning recovery while buyers attempt to stabilize above the quarterly open — a contested zone with high directional significance.
